title: How Bubble Sort Works
instructions: What does bubble sort do on each pass through the list?

options.text: Compares adjacent elements and swaps them if they are out of order
Splits the list in half and sorts each half
Picks a random element and moves it to the front

explanation: Bubble sort compares each pair of adjacent elements. If the first element is larger than the second, it swaps them. After one full pass, the largest element has 'bubbled up' to the end of the list.
